sources.title: 记忆张量获亿元Pre-A轮融资：华为、荣耀、商汤投资，创始人熊飞宇曾任职阿里
sources.venue_or_author: 新浪财经 (via Google News RSS)
sources.summary: Per headline (article body not fetched): Shanghai memory startup MemTensor (记忆张量), maker of MemOS, closed a ~RMB 100M (亿元) Pre-A round backed by Huawei, Honor and SenseTime; founder Xiong Feiyu (熊飞宇) previously worked at Alibaba. key_facts: MemTensor (记忆张量) raised ~RMB 100M (亿元) Pre-A, reported Jul 20 2026 (per headline, 新浪财经 via gnews RSS)
Investors named: Huawei (华为), Honor (荣耀), SenseTime (商汤) — hardware/AI big-tech strategic money, not USD VC (per headline)

sources.title: MemTensor/MemOS (GitHub repository)
sources.summary: MemOS is MemTensor's open-source 'memory operating system' for LLMs/agents: unified APIs for store/retrieve/edit/delete, memory as an inspectable graph, multi-modal memory (text, images, tool traces, personas), Multi-Cube isolated memory spaces, and async ingestion via MemScheduler. Apache 2.0, 11,000+ stars and ~1,000 forks as of Aug 24 2026, with 2026 updates including agent-harness integrations.
key_facts: 11,000+ GitHub stars, ~1,000 forks, Apache 2.0 license as of Aug 24 2026
Reported benchmarks: 88.83 LoCoMo, 89.20 LongMemEval, and a claimed 35.24% token saving vs baseline
Claims agent task completion lift from 36.63% to 50.87% with memory enabled (repo, 2026 updates)

sources.title: MemOS product site (openmem.net)
sources.summary: MemTensor's commercial surface for MemOS: open-source core plus MemOS Lite (fully local, zero cloud dependency) and MemOS Cloud (managed, '5-minute integration, millisecond response') with tiered pricing from Free to custom Enterprise. Ecosystem products include Memmy (personal memory hub) and ClawForce (enterprise agent platform). Named partners include Trip.com, Anker, Haier, Alibaba Cloud, China Telecom and Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
key_facts: Cloud free tier: 50K memory adds / 20K searches monthly; Pro tier listed $0 promo (originally $286) for 80M adds/30M searches (site, Aug 2026)
Enterprise partners named: Trip.com, Anker, Haier, Alibaba Cloud, China Telecom, SJTU — evidence of Chinese enterprise adoption
Offers fully-local MemOS Lite — fits on-prem/sovereignty (信创) deployment demand

sources.title: MemOS: A Memory OS for AI System
sources.summary: The research paper underpinning MemOS (arXiv:2507.03724, v4 updated Dec 3 2025), positioning memory as an operating-system-level resource for AI systems. Verified via arXiv export API; anchors MemTensor's academic credibility (SJTU-linked team) behind the commercial products.
key_facts: arXiv:2507.03724, latest v4 dated Dec 3 2025 (arXiv API, checked Aug 24 2026)
Formalizes OS-style memory management for LLM systems — the research basis of the funded MemTensor company

sources.title: 阿里云百炼（Model Studio）长期记忆文档
sources.summary: Alibaba Cloud Bailian's built-in long-term memory (长期记忆) for agent/workflow apps: auto-extracted 'memory nodes' from conversations plus manually defined 'memory variables' (which override nodes), recalled by memory ID and injected with each user question; memory IDs can be shared across apps for consistent user profiles. As of Aug 2026 the docs state memory storage is free and memory tokens are 'currently not charged' — the hyperscaler bundles memory at zero price.
key_facts: Bailian memory = auto memory nodes + manual memory variables, recalled per memory ID (docs, accessed Aug 24 2026)
Storage free and memory-content tokens 'currently not charged' — platform memory given away, squeezing standalone memory vendors
Memory IDs shareable across applications for one user profile; indefinite retention until deleted

sources.title: 腾讯云大模型知识引擎 / Agent开发平台 (ADP) 产品页

Free trial plus subscription tiers; pricing scales with model type, volume, concurrency. Related Apr 2026 launches (per 智东西/央广网 headlines) include an Agent Portal for unified enterprise agent management.
key_facts: Tencent Cloud LKE/ADP: agentic RAG + multi-agent framework, compliance-focused enterprise verticals (product page, accessed Aug 24 2026)
Priced by model type, call volume, concurrency; free trial tier exists
Tencent VP Li Qiang: enterprise Agent entering '产业实战期' (industry combat phase), Apr 28 2026 (per 央广网 headline)

sources.title: coze-dev/coze-studio (GitHub repository)
sources.summary: Coze Studio is the open-sourced core engine of ByteDance's Coze agent platform (which had 'served tens of thousands of enterprises and millions of developers'). No/low-code agent building with knowledge bases, databases, variables, and memory features that let agents answer 'based on a personal user's historical conversations'. Apache 2.0; 21.5k stars, 3.1k forks as of Aug 24 2026 — ByteDance giving away the platform-memory layer as OSS.
key_facts: Coze Studio: 21.5k stars, 3.1k forks, Apache 2.0 as of Aug 24 2026
Ships knowledge bases, databases, variables and per-user conversation memory as free open-source platform features
Commercial Coze platform claims tens of thousands of enterprises, millions of developers (repo README)

sources.title: langgenius/dify (GitHub repository)
sources.summary: Dify (LangGenius; Chinese-founded, heavily used in China) is the dominant open-source LLM-app platform: agentic workflows, full RAG pipeline from document ingestion to retrieval, LLMOps; 153.4k stars / 24.2k forks as of Aug 24 2026 under a modified-Apache 'Dify Open Source License'. Cloud, self-hosted community, and paid enterprise editions. Chinese coverage (雪球, Mar 2025 per headline) called Dify and Monica the two big Chinese-origin global Agent players, with deployments into carriers, government and finance via partners.
key_facts: Dify: 153.4k GitHub stars, 24.2k forks as of Aug 24 2026; Apache-2.0-based custom license
Full RAG/knowledge-base pipeline and agent workflows self-hostable — fits Chinese on-prem/sovereignty procurement

sources.title: Manus (AI agent) — Wikipedia
sources.summary: Full Manus arc: Butterfly Effect (founded 2022, Beijing/Wuhan; Monica browser extension 2023; Manus built from Oct 2024). Seed by ZhenFund 2023; Series A Nov 2024 (Sequoia China, Tencent); Series B Apr 2025 ~$75M at ~$500M valuation led by Benchmark. Mid-2025 the three co-founders moved to Singapore, ~40 of ~120 China staff relocated, rest laid off. Meta announced acquisition Dec 2025 at $2-3B; MOFCOM investigated Jan 2026; NDRC blocked Apr 27 2026; Meta unwound Jun 15 2026; Manus declared independent operations Aug 11 2026.
key_facts: Series B Apr 2025: ~$75M at ~$500M valuation, led by Benchmark; co-founders relocated to Singapore mid-2025
Meta acquisition announced Dec 2025 at $2-3B; China (NDRC) blocked Apr 27 2026; Meta unwound Jun 15 2026
Manus announced independent operations Aug 11 2026; ~100 staff, mostly Singapore (Wikipedia, accessed Aug 24 2026)

notes: CAPS USED: 18/18 search calls, 11/12 WebFetch. Google News redirector URLs could not be resolved to publisher pages (JS-only redirect; batchexecute recipe broken), so headline-attributed facts are marked 'per headline' and carry the gnews RSS URL — treat figures as reported-not-verified. VERIFIED-BY-FETCH sources: MemOS GitHub + openmem.net, arXiv 2507.03724, Bailian long-term-memory docs, Tencent cloud.tencent.com/product/lke, Coze Studio + Dify repos, Wikipedia Manus + DeepSeek. KEY SYNTHESIS FOR THE REPORTS: (1) China has a funded memory-native champion — MemTensor/MemOS (~RMB100M Pre-A, Jul 2026, Huawei/Honor/SenseTime money, SJTU-linked research, 11k-star OSS, cloud tiers, enterprise logos Trip/Haier/China Telecom) — its funding is strategic-CVC/state-adjacent, unlike US memory startups (contrast: Mem0 raised $24M from YC/Peak XV, Nov 4 2025, per QQ headline gnews CBMiVkFVX3lxTE1rVnhIZWFTQ1BBX3plRE9fa3FUWllzZjNaZDhkRlloMkIxc2FidEt6T0g1NDZvMVJMYk5vV0gySjhYX3ZsQ0JlbVZRdXNnSmhjanZ0MXNB; DeepSeek's first round reportedly state-Big-Fund-led at $45B pre-money; Big Fund also made first embodied-AI bet 银河通用 RMB2.5B, Mar 2 2026 per 财联社 headline). (2) Hyperscalers bundle memory free: Bailian long-term memory storage+tokens currently uncharged; ByteDance open-sourced Coze Studio (Apache 2.0); Dify 153k stars self-hostable — platform giveaway + open-weight DeepSeek V4 (MIT, 1M context) = severe commoditization pressure on any paid US context product. (3) Market access is bilaterally closing: Meta-Manus $2B deal blocked by NDRC Apr 27 2026, unwound Jun 15 2026; 'Singapore washing' red lines; Beijing pressuring startups to refuse US money — a US context startup faces both a hard-to-enter China market (xinchuang on-prem procurement, 双备案 filing, PIPL, new Agent rules) and Chinese-founded rivals (Genspark $2.6B, explicitly marketing 'context not models') competing freely in the US. (4) Context economics whiplash: 2025-H1 2026 permanent price cuts (DeepSeek V4-Pro to 1/4 price May 25 2026; Xiaomi followed) then Aug 2026 reversal — DeepSeek raising/off-peak-discounting while OpenAI cuts, because agent workloads exploded token volume (QQ Aug 18 2026): cheap tokens weaken 'save tokens' pitches, but agent-driven volume makes context management a cost-control necessity. NOT COVERED (budget exhausted): Volcano Engine's specific memory/context-cache product docs (only old Dec 2024 headlines found); Zilliz/vector-DB funding 2026; MemPrivacy (36Kr May 15 2026 headline exists on AI-memory privacy); NYT Jul 19 2026 'Alibaba AI hard to monetize' (gnews CBMickFVX3lxTE4wZ2pQY0szQ1ppaVBBLUpBVTQzc0stVExrOUVNZmFuME4zUHQtVkxZMUFVeTdVYmpLX0xWbE9xRk5JR01pXzd3QzlEdWUxeUFUM3hnb2pvb1NEOFh0anBBTTAzZy1Za05faElxZTl2VWtOdw) is a good monetization-pressure cite if needed.
